title: Facebook Channel (Auto-DM + Comment Support)
overview: Add Facebook Pages as a second channel in openreply behind a channel-provider seam: generalize InstagramAccount to SocialAccount with a platform enum, introduce a ChannelProvider contract (Instagram provider delegates to the existing lib/meta/client.ts; Facebook provider is new code against graph.facebook.com), dispatch webhooks by object with a hard noise filter on page/feed events, add FB Login for Business OAuth with a Page picker, and make the UI platform-aware (follow gate is Instagram-only and must degrade visibly). Standard Access only — no App Review; own Pages run under App Roles exactly like the current Instagram tester setup. ~2 weeks eng, 7 epics, 21 stories, 75 points.

primary: Connect a Facebook Page and run comment→DM automations with parity for every capability FB supports (private reply plain/button/link-button, reveal on postback, read fallback, public reply, DM keyword trigger, follow-up, tracking, billing)
Zero Instagram regression — existing suite green at every story boundary
One pipeline: worker/matcher/rate-limiter/dedup/billing untouched; platform resolved once through a provider seam, never branched inside flow bodies
secondary: Simpler FB token lifecycle (Page tokens never expire; refresh cron becomes IG-only)
Self-hoster docs for the no-App-Review Facebook path

epics.name: platform-foundation — schema + naming generalization
epics.description: Data-preserving rename of InstagramAccount to SocialAccount with a SocialPlatform enum and externalId, FK renames across Automation/DmLog/LinkClick/FollowerSnapshot/ProcessedComment, queue-payload generalization to {platform, externalAccountId}, codebase-wide identifier sweep (~41 files), FACEBOOK_APP_ID env plumbing, and the pre-coding Standard Access recipient probe against the production DmLog.
shared_design_concerns: Hand-written SQL renames only — Prisma default drop/create loses data
Compound unique [platform, externalId]; all lookups platform-scoped
Drain in-flight Redis jobs at deploy across the payload rename

stories.title: Standard Access recipient probe on prod DmLog
acceptance_criteria: The feasibility note's DmLog SQL is run against production and the verdict (strangers vs testers in commenterId) is recorded with evidence in the cliff note
If testers-only, the note records that the ceiling already exists on IG and the build proceeds either way
stories.technical_context: SELECT commenterId, commenterName, status, dmSentAt FROM DmLog WHERE status='SENT' ORDER BY dmSentAt DESC LIMIT 20; strangers present ⇒ Standard Access suffices on the recipient side ⇒ identical for FB.

stories.title: SocialAccount migration (data-preserving)
acceptance_criteria: Prisma schema: SocialAccount with platform SocialPlatform @default(INSTAGRAM), externalId, @@unique([platform, externalId]); FK/relation renames to socialAccountId/socialAccount on Automation, DmLog, LinkClick, FollowerSnapshot; ProcessedComment string column renamed
One hand-written SQL migration using ALTER TABLE/COLUMN RENAME — no drop/create of renamed tables
Applied to a seeded copy: row counts and FK integrity asserted; existing rows read back as platform=INSTAGRAM

stories.title: Codebase rename sweep onto SocialAccount
acceptance_criteria: Client regenerated; ~41 source files swept: instagramAccount(Id)→socialAccount(Id), instagramId→externalId; lib/instagram-accounts.ts → lib/social-accounts.ts with getWorkspaceSocialAccount/canConnectSocialAccount
Queue payloads carry {platform, externalAccountId}; shared route query param renamed to socialAccountId
tsc --noEmit, eslint, and full vitest suite green; zero references to old Prisma identifiers outside migrations; PR notes the Redis queue drain at deploy

stories.title: Facebook env plumbing
acceptance_criteria: FACEBOOK_APP_ID added to serverEnvSchema; getMissingFacebookOAuthEnv preflight mirrors the Instagram one
Env tests cover the missing/present matrix; .env.example and docs list the new variable

epics.name: channel-provider-seam — one pipeline, resolved per platform
epics.description: Define the ChannelProvider contract (sendPrivateReply/sendDirectMessage ± Button/LinkButton, replyToComment, getRecentComments, listPosts, getConversations, subscribeWebhooks, getFollowStatus — null on FB, refreshToken — no-op on FB) with a resolveChannel registry; Instagram provider delegates to lib/meta/client.ts; worker processors, reconciler, routes, and the token-refresh cron consume the seam with zero platform conditionals in flow bodies. Core: the automation pipeline's delivery invariants (one private reply per comment, idempotent public reply, gate semantics) live here.
shared_design_concerns: Strategy — because send/read/refresh semantics vary by platform behind one worker-facing contract; revisit at build (may collapse to a keyed object literal of two providers)
Adapter — because each provider normalizes a distinct Graph dialect to shared ChannelComment/ChannelPost types; revisit at build (may collapse into the strategy implementations)
No if(platform) inside worker flow bodies, routes, or reconciler (N-5)
Follow gate degrades visibly on FB: UI hides, API rejects, worker warns via OperationalEvent (FR-5)

stories.title: Channel contract + Instagram provider
acceptance_criteria: lib/channels/{types,instagram,index}.ts: contract with params objects, resolveChannel registry, Instagram provider delegating to existing lib/meta/client.ts functions
Contract unit-tested through the IG provider against mocked fetch; getFollowStatus and refreshToken behavior preserved exactly; no call-site changes yet

stories.title: Worker on the seam
acceptance_criteria: processComment/processPostback/processFollowUp/processMessage and sendRevealDirectMessage resolve a provider from the job's platform; zero platform conditionals in flow bodies
Follow-gate guarded per FR-5: FB automation with requireFollow proceeds gate-less and writes an OperationalEvent WARNING
Existing dm-worker tests green; new tests for platform resolution and the FB requireFollow warning path

stories.title: Reconciler + routes + cron on the seam
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler uses provider.getRecentComments/listPosts with normalized ownerReplied; sweep caps unchanged
posts/conversations/overview routes resolve the provider; token-refresh cron filters platform=INSTAGRAM
Reconciler tests cover both reply-edge shapes; cron test proves FB rows are never selected

epics.name: facebook-connect — OAuth + Page picker
epics.description: FB Login for Business flow: dialog with scopes pages_show_list, pages_messaging, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_engagement, pages_manage_metadata; code → short user token → fb_exchange_token long-lived user token held in an encrypted 10-minute httpOnly cookie; GET /me/accounts Page picker; selected Page's never-expiring token encrypted onto SocialAccount(platform=FACEBOOK, tokenExpiresAt=null) with the cross-workspace guard; subscribed_apps with feed,messages,messaging_postbacks,message_reads; ?facebook= status codes mirroring ?instagram=.
shared_design_concerns: Long-lived user token never persisted — encrypted short-TTL cookie only
Reuse createOAuthState HMAC and AES-GCM helpers

stories.title: Facebook OAuth module
acceptance_criteria: lib/meta/facebook-oauth.ts: dialog URL builder with the five scopes, code→short-token and fb_exchange_token exchanges
Unit tests with mocked fetch: happy path, Meta error bodies, state round-trip

stories.title: Page connect routes + picker backend
acceptance_criteria: app/api/facebook/{connect,callback,pages}: session/canManageWorkspace/env-preflight guards, encrypted 10-min cookie carrying the user token, paged /me/accounts listing, POST persists the selected Page and subscribes webhooks
Token stored encrypted with tokenExpiresAt=null; webhookSubscribed reflects the subscribe result; cookie cleared after selection
Route tests for guard/env/state failures and cross-workspace already_connected

epics.name: facebook-provider — Graph implementation
epics.description: Facebook ChannelProvider against graph.facebook.com sharing handleResponse and the MetaApiError taxonomy: messaging sends via POST /{page-id}/messages (recipient comment_id or id; button/web_url payloads identical to IG), public reply via POST /{comment-id}/comments, recent comments with the nested comments reply edge, posts via published_posts + video_reels merged, conversations, and daily fan_count snapshots into FollowerSnapshot.
shared_design_concerns: Comments lacking from (privacy-restricted users) are skipped — the pipeline requires a commenter identity
No Graph shapes leak past the provider (normalized ChannelComment/ChannelPost)

stories.title: Facebook messaging sends
acceptance_criteria: sendPrivateReply/sendDirectMessage ± Button/LinkButton against POST /{page-id}/messages with 640-char text and 20-char title truncation
Meta errors mapped through MetaApiError/TokenExpiredError/RateLimitError/PermissionError; fixture tests per send variant

stories.title: Facebook comments + posts read paths
acceptance_criteria: replyToComment, getRecentComments (nested comments edge → ownerReplied, paginated within lookback), listPosts (published_posts + video_reels merged desc), getConversations
Fixture tests include comments missing from, pagination, and reel/post merge order

stories.title: Facebook fan-count snapshots

epics.name: facebook-webhooks — dispatch + hard noise filter
epics.description: Webhook route dispatches by payload.object; parseFacebookCommentEvents accepts only field:feed events with item==comment && verb==add, dropping likes/shares/statuses/reactions/edits/removes, Page-authored comments, and comments missing from; entry.messaging parsers generalized to accept object page as well as instagram; account lookups move to [platform, externalId]; deterministic job ids hold with FB postid_commentid ids.
shared_design_concerns: Feed-noise immunity (N-2) is the highest-risk correctness surface — exhaustive drop fixtures
Unknown webhook objects: record WebhookEvent, return 200

stories.title: Facebook feed comment parser with hard filter
acceptance_criteria: parseFacebookCommentEvents emits {platform:FACEBOOK, externalAccountId, commentId, mediaId(post_id), commenter} only for item==comment && verb==add with a from.id
Fixture tests prove drops for like, share, status, reaction, edit, remove, Page-authored, and missing-from events

stories.title: Webhook dispatch by object + shared messaging parsers
acceptance_criteria: Route dispatches object instagram|page; messaging/postback/read parsers accept page; account lookup by [platform, externalId]; job id shapes unchanged
End-to-end route tests enqueue correct jobs for object:page comment/message/postback/read payloads; object:instagram fixtures behave byte-identically; unknown object → 200 + recorded WebhookEvent

epics.name: dual-channel-ui
epics.description: Settings gains a Facebook connect button, Page-picker step, platform badges, per-platform status notices, and disconnect parity; the campaign builder becomes platform-aware (follow gate hidden with an Instagram-only explainer for FB accounts, API rejects requireFollow on FB, post picker renders FB posts/reels); overview labels the fan series and degrades gracefully where FB lacks an IG metric.
shared_design_concerns: Follow-gate hiding is capability-driven off platform, not hardcoded per page
Platform badge appears everywhere an account is rendered (FR-9)

A connected FB account renders with badge and subscribe state

shared_design_concerns: Live smoke is the only networked validation; everything else runs on fixtures

Each leg evidenced (screenshot/log) in the cliff note

stories.title: Self-hoster docs for the Facebook path
acceptance_criteria: docs/setup.md Facebook section (app config, App Roles, scopes, no-review rationale); META_APP_REVIEW.md Facebook paragraph; README channel matrix; .env.example updated
Docs walk a fresh self-hoster to a connected Page without App Review

stories.title: Cross-platform hardening fixtures
acceptance_criteria: One test per shared-machinery seam with FACEBOOK fixtures: rate-limiter reservation, usage billing increment, ProcessedComment/DmLog dedup with postid_commentid ids, link tracking rows carrying socialAccountId

dependencies: Existing Meta app with Instagram Login already configured (FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET present in serverEnvSchema)
BullMQ/Redis and Postgres as deployed; drain in-flight Redis jobs at the payload-rename deploy
Facebook account with a role on the app (App Roles) — Standard Access only, no App Review
design_concerns: Data-preserving SQL rename migration — never Prisma drop/create (verified on a seeded copy)
Seam discipline: platform varies only at provider resolution and in webhook parsers; no platform conditionals in worker flow bodies
Feed-noise immunity: only item==comment && verb==add enters the queue, with exhaustive drop fixtures
Follow gate has no FB analogue — hidden in UI, rejected by API, warned by worker (visible degradation)
Page tokens never expire: tokenExpiresAt=null, refresh cron scoped to INSTAGRAM
Long-lived user token held only in an encrypted 10-minute cookie during Page selection
Compound uniqueness [platform, externalId]; dedup and deterministic job ids hold with FB postid_commentid ids
Standard Access ceiling: nothing may depend on Advanced Access, App Review, or Business Verification
